title: No Enchant Particle!
description: Removes the enchant particle making you have better visibility over your pvp game! Super light-weight
body:
Ever get tired of the floating purple enchantment particles constantly covering your screen while playing Minecraft? Whether you’re PvPing, building, recording videos, or just trying to enjoy cleaner visuals, those particles can quickly become distracting and messy. That’s exactly why **No Enchant Particle** exists.

This overlay completely removes enchantment particles from the game, giving Minecraft a cleaner, smoother, and more modern look while keeping everything else fully vanilla-friendly. Enchanted items still keep their enchantment glint, so you can still tell what’s enchanted, but the annoying floating particles around players, mobs, and gear are gone.

The result is a much more polished gameplay experience.

This overlay is perfect for PvP players who need maximum visibility during fights. In fast-paced combat situations, unnecessary particles can block your vision, distract your focus, and make tracking opponents harder than it should be. Removing enchant particles makes fights feel cleaner and easier to read, especially in crystal PvP, boxing, BedWars, UHC, SMP combat, and duels.

But this overlay isn’t only for PvP players.

Builders and survival players will also love the cleaner visuals. Sometimes you just want Minecraft to look calm and smooth without purple particles flying around every enchanted tool, armor piece, or mob. No Enchant Particle helps keep the game looking neat while still staying true to the original Minecraft style.

Another huge advantage is compatibility. Since this is an overlay and not a full texture pack, it works perfectly on top of almost any resource pack. Whether you use a competitive PvP pack, a vanilla edit, realistic textures, or your own custom setup, No Enchant Particle blends in seamlessly without affecting the rest of your textures.

The overlay is lightweight, simple, and designed to do one thing perfectly: remove visual clutter.

Features:

* Removes enchantment particles completely
* Cleaner PvP experience
* Better visibility during combat
* Vanilla-friendly design
* Works with almost every texture pack
* Lightweight overlay
* Perfect for PvP, SMP, survival, and recording videos
* Keeps enchanted item glints intact
* Reduces unnecessary visual distractions

If you love clean Minecraft visuals, this overlay is probably something you’ll never want to uninstall after trying it once. The game instantly feels more polished, less distracting, and much easier on the eyes.

Simple change. Massive difference.

Download No Enchant Particle and experience cleaner Minecraft gameplay.
